title: Warlocks #10 Aircel Comics 1989 Warlock 5 Spinoff Vintage Fantasy Comic Book
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Warlocks #10 (1989), Aircel Comics - the Warlock 5 spinoff series. Original $1.95 cover price ($2.35 in Canada).

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
